core: Type III interferon and IL-20 family signaling
qualifier: epithelial antiviral defense and wound repair
name: Type III interferon and IL-20 family epithelial defense and repair
rationale: Members are interferon-alpha/type III interferon responses, IL-20 family signaling and epithelial wound-healing regulation, i.e. IL-10-superfamily cytokines acting on epithelia; confusables instead carry IL-10/12/23/27, IL-17 or IL-15/NK signaling and lack the wound-repair members.

name: Dolichol-phosphate mannose donor synthesis and GPI anchoring
rationale: Members cover GDP-mannose, dolichyl-phosphate and dolichyl-phosphate-mannose synthesis with their CDG defects, plus GPI anchor synthesis and attachment; the GPI members separate it from confusables built on ALG-driven lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, N-glycan processing or UDP-GlcNAc synthesis.

name: Glutathione synthesis, recycling and methylglyoxal detoxification
rationale: Members span the gamma-glutamyl cycle and its enzyme defects, cystine/glutathione transport, ferroptosis restraint and glutathione-dependent methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification with glycation protein repair; confusables center on vitamin B6/molybdenum cofactor, ROS/NADPH, or transsulfuration and selenium metabolism.

name: Mitochondrial respiratory electron transport and complex IV assembly
rationale: Members are the respiratory chain, oxidative phosphorylation and chemiosmotic ATP formation together with complex IV, complex I and respirasome assembly; confusables instead feature complex III and ATP synthase assembly, inner-membrane protein insertion or mitochondrial translation.

core: Mycobacterium tuberculosis manipulation of host cell
qualifier: suppression of apoptosis, autophagy, nitric oxide and membrane repair
name: Mycobacterium tuberculosis suppression of host cell defenses
rationale: Every member is an Mtb strategy that blunts host defenses (immune modulation, apoptosis, autophagy, NO, membrane repair, phagolysosome fusion, energy metabolism), whereas confusables cover Mtb nutrient/iron acquisition, phagosome acidification, or other pathogens and toxins.

name: Membrane-proximal canonical Wnt receptor signaling and regulation
rationale: Members act at the Frizzled/LRP5-DVL level (DVL activation, destruction complex disassembly, RNF43 and FZD ubiquitination, LRP5 mutants, ligand antagonists); confusables are nuclear beta-catenin/TCF events or non-canonical and Wnt secretion pathways.

name: RUNX3- and FOXO-driven growth-suppressive gene transcription
rationale: Most members are transcriptional control of tumor-suppressive targets (RUNX3 on CDKN1A, BIM and p14-ARF, FOXO cell-cycle genes, PTEN) with PAX3 target modules and ALK/MAPK6-4 nuclear signaling as looser additions; confusables center on CDH1/CDH11 transcription or TGF-beta/SMAD signaling.

name: Postsynaptic actin remodeling, structural plasticity and dendrite arborization
rationale: Members concern postsynaptic actin organization, PSD maintenance, synapse structural plasticity, local translation and dendrite arborization; confusables emphasize filopodia and RHO GTPase cytoskeleton, spine maturation, or BDNF/TRK signaling.

name: Mammary alveolar differentiation, lactation and involution
rationale: All but one member (response to hyperoxia) describe the pregnancy-lactation cycle of mammary alveolar epithelium; confusables instead cover placental/trophoblast development, ductal branching or mammary lineage modules.

core: Cranial sensory organ and cranial nerve development
name: Cranial placode-derived ear, olfactory and cranial nerve development
rationale: Members cover inner/middle/outer ear, nose and olfactory nerve, taste papillae, cranial ganglia and nerves, hindbrain branchiomotor neurons and GnRH neuron migration from the olfactory placode; confusables center on the eye, craniofacial skeleton or exocrine glands.

name: mRNA stabilization, decapping decay and nuclear processing regulation
rationale: Members regulate mRNA processing, export, stabilization (IGF2BP, CRD, 3'-UTR, decay inhibition), decapping/5'-3' decay and translation; confusables focus on polyadenylation or on ARE-binding destabilization and stress granules.

name: Base excision repair gap filling, short- and long-patch
rationale: All members are the post-incision BER steps (abasic sugar removal, POLB and PCNA-dependent long patch, gap filling); confusables cover glycosylase lesion recognition, OGG1 defects, replication or translesion synthesis.

name: Neuroactive drug responses and agmatine–nitric oxide suppression
rationale: Members are responses to ethanol, ether, nicotine, anesthetics and an alcohol-use module plus agmatine synthesis and negative regulation of NO and amine metabolism; confusables cover xenobiotic/pesticide or antibiotic and oxidative-stress responses.

name: Locomotion, posture and motor coordination behavior
rationale: Members are locomotor, grooming, righting, proprioceptive and voluntary movement behaviors with cerebellar Purkinje layer and amygdala development; confusables emphasize vocalization, learning, sensory behaviors or glycinergic transmission.
Four unrelated gene modules (RB1/BCL2L1 survival, Polycomb chromatin, mitochondrial housekeeping, centrosomal mitosis) plus a generic ubiquitination module share no specific biological process.

core: Glutamate receptor signaling in synaptic plasticity
qualifier: NMDA receptor calcium coupling to CREB
name: NMDA receptor–calcium–CREB signaling in plasticity and memory
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA receptor activation and trafficking, postsynaptic calcium, CaMK/cAMP-driven CREB and NPAS4 activation, LTP/LTD and memory; confusables lack the CREB/nuclear arm and instead emphasize structural plasticity or kainate/AMPA activation.

name: Non-coding RNA methylation and box C/D snoRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are tRNA, rRNA (base and 2'-O) and snRNA methylation/modification with box C/D snoRNP assembly and snoRNA localization; confusables cover rRNA cleavage processing, nuclear RNA decay, pseudouridylation or mitochondrial RNA modification.

name: Mitochondrial protein localization and membrane potential regulation
rationale: Members concern targeting and retention of proteins in mitochondria and regulation of mitochondrial membrane potential; confusables are mitophagy, fission/fusion and apoptotic outer-membrane permeabilization.

name: Respiratory chain electron transport and complex III/IV assembly
rationale: Members are the respiratory chain and oxidative phosphorylation with complex III, IV and respirasome assembly and inner-membrane protein insertion; confusables feature complex I biogenesis, ATP synthase assembly, mitochondrial translation or Fe-S cluster assembly.

name: Peptidyl lysine and arginine methylation and protein acetylation
rationale: Members are lysine mono/di/trimethylation, arginine methylation, lysine and N-terminal acetylation, HAT activity and TP53/tubulin modification; confusables center on chromatin remodeling complexes, histone methyltransferase complexes or DNA methylation.

qualifier: HGF–MET and TGF-beta/activin, with cancer mutants
name: HGF–MET and TGF-beta/activin receptor signaling with oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members combine HGF/MET (and MST1) receptor signaling with TGF-beta, activin and AMH receptor signaling, TGFBR3 regulation and cancer mutants of TGFBR/SMAD; confusables carry PTK6/ERBB, ALK/PI3K or liver-development members instead.

qualifier: ER-based, for glycolipids, phospholipids and sterols
name: ER-based intermembrane transfer of glycolipids, phospholipids and sterols
rationale: Members are non-vesicular transport of glycosphingolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate, PI/PC and cholesterol with ER tethering and localization; confusables cover ER-mitochondria tethering, RAB prenylation, phospholipid catabolism or flippases.

core: Germline and early embryo epigenetic programming
qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing and zygotic chromatin reprogramming
name: Germline piRNA transposon silencing and zygotic chromatin reprogramming
rationale: Members span piRNA biogenesis and retroelement silencing, sperm chromatin condensation and protamine replacement, oocyte construction and maternal-to-zygotic chromatin changes and ZGA; confusables emphasize germ cell specification, imprinting, X inactivation or maternal mRNA decay.

name: APC/C- and SCF-controlled G2/M progression and mitotic exit
rationale: Members cover G2/M checkpoint and transition, cyclin/CDK regulation and APC/C- and SCF-mediated cyclin/securin degradation through mitotic exit; confusables center on E2F-driven G1/S and replication or on spindle and cohesion machinery.

name: Phagosome maturation and its subversion by Mycobacterium tuberculosis
rationale: Members are phagosome acidification and lysosome fusion, neutrophil phagocytosis and Mtb strategies blocking them and acquiring iron/heme; confusables cover Listeria entry, toxins, or neutrophil granule and peptide transport modules.
